name: vk-ads
description: VK Ads (VK Реклама) via the local mcp-vk-ads npm server: ad plans, banners, statistics, budgets. Connect from the chat with your VK Ads API app (client_id + client_secret, auto-refreshed); a ready-made token is optional (agency clients, CI). Requires Node.js 20+.

token.title: VK Ads access token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty to connect from the chat ("connect VK Ads"). Needed only for agency client accounts or CI; such a token lives about a day and is not refreshed.
